subject: Inference growth opportunities & timeline — post-call summary
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@lumenlytics.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@lumenlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Inference growth opportunities & timeline — post-call summary

Hi Raj / Hannah —

Thanks for taking the time today — good conversation and lots of alignment. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Key pain points you described
- Rising inference cost as RAG traffic scales (esp. larger context windows + embeddings).
- p95 latency spikes during peak batch writes affecting search freshness.
- Security/controls: need SSO, audit logs, and a path for VPC data handling.

2) Goals you called out
- Reduce per-query inference spend ~30% within next 6 months while keeping answer quality.
- Achieve p95 <150ms for our QA endpoints; tolerate slight increases for long-context RAG.
- Run a 6-week dedicated pilot migrating two RAG pipelines and embeddings refresh flow.

3) Pilot scope (high-level)
- Migrate one customer-facing RAG (3M monthly queries) + nightly embedding refresh.
- Success metrics: cost/unit, p95 latency, top-1 retrieval precision on holdout set.
- Security: scoped VPC + audit log delivery to your SIEM; SSO for team access.

4) Immediate asks / next steps
- Rachel/Marissa: we'll send a draft pilot scope + cost estimate (attached).
- Karthik: to propose quantization/options that preserve precision on your models.
- Raj/Hannah: confirm data residency requirement (US-only?) and a 2–3 person list for technical onboarding.
- Proposed timeline: kickoff week of June 7; 6-week pilot; procurement decision by end of Q3.

Attachments: LumenLytics-MAAP-Estimate.pdf (cost sketch), redwood-pilot-checklist.xlsx (milestones).

I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for kickoff once we lock the tech attendees — thanks again.

Best,
Rachel Kim

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Inference growth opportunities & timeline — post-call summary

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: must remain US-only for customer PII pipelines (we can run non-PII testing in EU if helpful but not a requirement).
- Procurement timeline: looking to finalize vendor by end of Q3, but procurement + security review may take 6–8 weeks after pilot if everything looks good.
- Models: we currently run a mix of Llama 2-70B finetuned + a smaller private LLM for embeddings. Can Redwood support mixed-architecture serving and quantized 8-bit paths?

Also: our security team will want a short questionnaire (SOC2 questions + encryption-at-rest details). Can you point us to the standard pack?

I shared the two technical contacts below for the kickoff invite: 
- Hannah Lee (hannah.lee@lumenlytics.com) — Platform lead
- Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@lumenlytics.com) — Infra lead

Looking forward — Raj

Subject: Re: Inference growth opportunities & timeline — technical notes

Hi all — following up with technical clarifications and what we'd like to validate during the pilot: 

- Mixed architecture support: yes — Redwood runtime can serve both 70B and smaller embedding models concurrently. We'll route by model tag and can fallback to a lower-cost variant when capacity constrained.
- Quantization & perf: 8-bit quantization + kernel selection reduces memory and cost substantially; for your 70B finetuned model, we estimate throughput uplift of ~2.5x with negligible quality loss on our eval prompt set. We'll run an eval pass on a 5k holdout of your queries during the pilot.
- Batching strategy: we'll instrument continuous batching for short queries and a small-batch fast-path for latency-sensitive calls to meet the <150ms p95 target.
- KV/prefix caching: we recommend pre-warming the KV cache for the two primary namespaces — attaching a suggested config and a tiny example file.

Attachment: kv-cache-config.json (sample), and a short test-plan we'll use during the first 2 weeks.

Concrete asks for the kickoff:
1) A 5k sample of anonymized queries + expected labels for eval.
2) Confirmation that we can deliver logs to your SIEM (formatting options: syslog/S3).

I'll schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff once we have the sample and confirmation.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
